values.note: A single roadside site, 003, Braddock Division of Forbes State Forest, on Kirby Road, 0.9 mile from Skyline Drive (off Route 40). Pull-Through, max vehicle length 30 ft; site pad 125 x 15 ft with a 60-ft gravel driveway, slight grade, 20-ft overhead clearance, partial shade. All equipment must fit on the site pad; no more than 2 vehicles.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880267&siteId=29385 ('Max Vehicle Length: 30', 'Driveway Entry: Pull-Through', 'Driveway Surface: Gravel', 'Driveway Length: 60', 'Site Length: 125', 'Site Width: 15'; 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Greater than 300 feet'; Site Limitations), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Open April 2 to the last day of the regular rifle deer season (ReserveAmerica shows 'Open through Fri Dec 11 2026'); closed for winter, and forest roads are not plowed.

season.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/forbes/camping ('Motorized, roadside campsites are available from April 2 to last day of regular rifle deer season'; 'Forbes State Forest campsites are closed for the winter season from the last day of regular rifle deer season to April 2 annually') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880267&siteId=29385 ('Status: Open through Fri Dec 11 2026'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: A permit and reservation are always required; reserve online or at 888-PA-PARKS. Forbes asks campers to take no more than one permit a month. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/forbes/camping ('Camping permits and reservations are required to stay at motorized, roadside campsites', 'may be reserved up to eleven months in advance', 'Stays are limited to seven nights at a motorized, roadside campsite', 'please obtain no more than one permit per month', 'Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880267&siteId=29385 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific'); noon cutoff as recorded from the DCNR motorized roadside camping page, read 2026-10-20

summary: Matched to ReserveAmerica site 003, Braddock Division by coordinates. Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single pull-through roadside site with a 30-ft max vehicle length, reservation always required (fcfs never), season April 2 to the end of rifle deer season, one-permit-a-month request. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate. Note rewritten as clean prose (it carried an audit remark as a second line); ReserveAmerica: 'Distance to Lake/Stream: Greater than 300 feet'.
flags: Phone: the entry has only the 888-PA-PARKS reservation line; the Forbes State Forest district office is 724-238-1200 (https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/forbes/camping).
Name: the booking site calls it '003, Braddock Division' (Forbes State Forest roadside site), not campsite #3.
note: Roadside campsite 003 (Braddock Division) on Kirby Road in Forbes State Forest. A small spring-fed pond is nearby, but the booking site puts the site more than 300 ft from any lake or stream. --Claude
